description: This file defines the final class MotionService that implements the MotionServicing protocol, providing methods to fetch motion activities and pedometer data using CoreMotion APIs.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A class that provides methods to retrieve motion activities and pedometer data asynchronously, using CoreMotion API calls, handling permissions and availability checks.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified date range, returning an array of movement entries with various activity flags.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data (steps, distance, floors) within a specified date range.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Converts ISO8601 string date parameters into Date objects, defaulting to start of the current day and current date if nil.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum to corresponding string representation.
